lines: Pull a knuckle, and the joint separates so fast that a tiny gap opens in the fluid. That's the pop.
It took until twenty fifteen for an M R I to film it.
So does it give you arthritis?
One doctor tested it on himself. For over sixty years, he cracked only his left hand, twice a day.
His right hand was the control.
Neither hand got arthritis, and he won an Ig Nobel prize.
A later study of two hundred fifteen people found no link either.
So no, it isn't your bones. Sorry, mom.
